jp: 薬物への逃避衝動と深い悲しみを振り払い、再び空へ羽ばたく白き鷹。後遺症の影響を受けながらも、確実に全盛期の実力を取り戻しつつある。
jp_grezzo: "薬物への逃避衝動と深い悲しみを振り払い、再び空へ羽ばたく白き鷹。後遺症の影響を受けながらも、確実に全盛期の実力を取り戻しつつある。"
en: A white hawk that shakes off the urge to flee to drugs and deep sorrow and flutters into the sky again. Despite being affected by the aftereffects he is steadily regaining the power he had in his prime.
en_grezzo: "A white hawk that shakes off the urge to flee to drugs and deep sorrow and flutters into the sky again. Despite being affected by the aftereffects he is steadily regaining the power he had in his prime."
it: Il falco bianco che si è scrollato di dosso il dolore profondo e la voglia di rifugiarsi nella droga, e ha ripreso a battere le ali verso il cielo. Gli strascichi si fanno ancora sentire, ma sta tornando senza incertezze alla forza dei suoi anni migliori.

jp: 束縛するのもされるのも大好き、という倒錯的な悪魔。神々に巨城へ叩き込まれたのだが、他の悪魔ほど力が制限されていない。持ち前の能力のせいで効き目が弱かったのだと思われる。
jp_grezzo: "束縛するのもされるのも大好き、という倒錯的な悪魔。神々に巨城へ叩き込まれたのだが、他の悪魔ほど力が制限されていない。持ち前の能力のせいで効き目が弱かったのだと思われる。"
en: She is a perverted demon who loves to be both bound and treated. She was thrown into a giant castle by the gods but her powers are not as limited as the other demons. It seems that the effect was less effective because of the ability she possessed.
en_grezzo: "She is a perverted demon who loves to be both bound and treated. She was thrown into a giant castle by the gods but her powers are not as limited as the other demons. It seems that the effect was less effective because of the ability she possessed."
it: Un demone dai gusti rovesciati: adora legare e adora essere legato. Gli dei l'hanno sbattuta dentro il castello immenso, ma i suoi poteri non sono limitati quanto quelli degli altri demoni. Si pensa che il sigillo abbia fatto meno presa proprio per via della facoltà che si ritrova.

jp: 恐怖の体現者。構ってちゃんであり、寂しくなると死んでしまうからなどという理由（もちろん嘘である）で誰彼構わず引き寄せ、阿鼻叫喚の地獄を作り出す。
jp_grezzo: "恐怖の体現者。構ってちゃんであり、寂しくなると死んでしまうからなどという理由（もちろん嘘である）で誰彼構わず引き寄せ、阿鼻叫喚の地獄を作り出す。"
en: The embodiment of fear. It is a caring person and when it gets lonely it will die etc. A lie of course. So it attracts everyone and creates a hell of a scene.
en_grezzo: "The embodiment of fear. It is a caring person and when it gets lonely it will die etc. A lie of course. So it attracts everyone and creates a hell of a scene."
it: Il terrore fatto carne. È uno di quelli che vogliono attenzione a tutti i costi: con la scusa che se resta solo muore, che è una bugia bella e buona, si tira addosso chiunque gli capiti e ne ricava un inferno di urla e di strazio.

jp: かつて神々の大戦時に、風の女神に敗北してしまい身体を引き裂かれた虹の女神…その破片を宿すリス。生まれたばかりの頃は破片の支配力が強いため、身体が虹色に発光する。
jp_grezzo: "かつて神々の大戦時に、風の女神に敗北してしまい身体を引き裂かれた虹の女神…その破片を宿すリス。生まれたばかりの頃は破片の支配力が強いため、身体が虹色に発光する。"
en: The goddess of the rainbow once defeated by the goddess of the wind in a great war between the gods which tore her body apart...these squirrels houses the pieces. When they are newborn their bodies glow a rainbow of colors due to the dominance of the fragments.
en_grezzo: "The goddess of the rainbow once defeated by the goddess of the wind in a great war between the gods which tore her body apart...these squirrels houses the pieces. When they are newborn their bodies glow a rainbow of colors due to the dominance of the fragments."
it: Ai tempi della grande guerra fra gli dei, la dea dell'arcobaleno fu sconfitta dalla dea del vento e ne ebbe il corpo squarciato: questo scoiattolo ospita una di quelle schegge. Appena nato la scheggia lo domina più che mai, e allora il corpo gli si accende dei colori dell'arcobaleno.

jp: 真っ白な兎。神として祭り上げられたことにより微弱ながらも神力を持つ。祖先の記憶が遺伝子に強く刷り込まれており、サメが苦手。縁結びが特技らしい。
jp_grezzo: "真っ白な兎。神として祭り上げられたことにより微弱ながらも神力を持つ。祖先の記憶が遺伝子に強く刷り込まれており、サメが苦手。縁結びが特技らしい。"
en: A pure white rabbit. It has a weak but divine power because it was raised as a god. Ancestral memories are strongly imprinted in its genes and it is not good at sharks. They are said to be good at matching couples.
en_grezzo: "A pure white rabbit. It has a weak but divine power because it was raised as a god. Ancestral memories are strongly imprinted in its genes and it is not good at sharks. They are said to be good at matching couples."
it: Un coniglio bianchissimo. A furia di essere innalzato a divinità si ritrova un potere divino, debole ma vero. La memoria degli antenati gli è rimasta stampata a fondo nel sangue, e per questo con gli squali non se la sente. Pare che la sua specialità sia far nascere le coppie.

jp: 兎社会に潜む怪物。夜な夜な墓を掘り返して遺体を食らうため、屍食兎とも呼ばれる。兎だけでなく他の生物をも魅了し、食料としてしまう。
jp_grezzo: "兎社会に潜む怪物。夜な夜な墓を掘り返して遺体を食らうため、屍食兎とも呼ばれる。兎だけでなく他の生物をも魅了し、食料としてしまう。"
en: A monster lurking in rabbit society. They are also called corpse-eating rabbits because they dig up graves at night and devour the bodies. It attracts not only rabbits but also other creatures and uses them as food.
en_grezzo: "A monster lurking in rabbit society. They are also called corpse-eating rabbits because they dig up graves at night and devour the bodies. It attracts not only rabbits but also other creatures and uses them as food."
it: Un mostro che si nasconde dentro la società dei conigli. Notte dopo notte scava nelle tombe e divora i corpi, e per questo lo chiamano anche il coniglio mangiacadaveri. Non attira soltanto i conigli: adesca anche le altre creature e se le mangia.

jp: リスこそが地上で最も尊い生物であるという考えのもとに行動する。土地の明け渡しと無条件降伏をあちこちに要求したが、当然拒否されたため無差別破壊活動に走った。
jp_grezzo: "リスこそが地上で最も尊い生物であるという考えのもとに行動する。土地の明け渡しと無条件降伏をあちこちに要求したが、当然拒否されたため無差別破壊活動に走った。"
en: They act on the idea that squirrels are the most noble creatures on earth. They demanded land surrender and unconditional surrender but were naturally refused so they went on an indiscriminate subversive campaign.
en_grezzo: "They act on the idea that squirrels are the most noble creatures on earth. They demanded land surrender and unconditional surrender but were naturally refused so they went on an indiscriminate subversive campaign."
it: Agisce partendo dal principio che lo scoiattolo sia la creatura più nobile che ci sia sulla terra. Ha preteso qua e là la consegna delle terre e la resa senza condizioni; naturalmente gli hanno detto di no, e allora si è dato alla distruzione a casaccio.

jp: 兎と亀の合成獣。遥か昔に兎と亀の徒競走があったらしいが、もしその場にこの生物がいた場合、結果はどうなっていただろうか。全ては亀のみぞ…もとい、神のみぞ知る。
jp_grezzo: "兎と亀の合成獣。遥か昔に兎と亀の徒競走があったらしいが、もしその場にこの生物がいた場合、結果はどうなっていただろうか。全ては亀のみぞ…もとい、神のみぞ知る。"
en: A synthetic beast of a rabbit and a tortoise. There was a race between a rabbit and a tortoise a long time ago and I wonder what the outcome would have been if this creature had been there. All things are in the hands of the tortoise... and God knows.
en_grezzo: "A synthetic beast of a rabbit and a tortoise. There was a race between a rabbit and a tortoise a long time ago and I wonder what the outcome would have been if this creature had been there. All things are in the hands of the tortoise... and God knows."
it: Una bestia sintetica, metà coniglio e metà tartaruga. Tanto tempo fa pare ci sia stata una gara di corsa fra una lepre e una tartaruga: chissà come sarebbe andata a finire se quel giorno ci fosse stata anche questa creatura. Lo sa soltanto la tartaru... pardon, soltanto il cielo.

jp: 鏡の世界に住む巨大蝙蝠。サバイバルを繰り返し、こちら側の世界にも適応した。疾風の如く空を駆ける。執着心が強く、一度捕食しようとした獲物は徹底的に狙う。
jp_grezzo: "鏡の世界に住む巨大蝙蝠。サバイバルを繰り返し、こちら側の世界にも適応した。疾風の如く空を駆ける。執着心が強く、一度捕食しようとした獲物は徹底的に狙う。"
en: The giant bat lives in the mirror world. It has adapted to this side of the world through repeated survival. It flies in the sky like a swift wind. They are obsessive and once they have attempted to prey on their prey they target them thoroughly.
en_grezzo: "The giant bat lives in the mirror world. It has adapted to this side of the world through repeated survival. It flies in the sky like a swift wind. They are obsessive and once they have attempted to prey on their prey they target them thoroughly."
it: Un pipistrello gigantesco che abita il mondo dello specchio. A furia di sopravvivere una volta dopo l'altra si è adattato anche al mondo di qua. Corre per il cielo come una raffica di vento. È di quelli che non mollano: la preda che ha deciso di mangiarsi una volta se la tiene di mira fino in fondo.

jp: 蝙蝠の神。闇にまぎれて、病気や悪魔から人々を守るヒーロー。普通の蝙蝠と間違われて、守るべき人々からよく攻撃されるのが悩みの種。特技は死んだふり。
jp_grezzo: "蝙蝠の神。闇にまぎれて、病気や悪魔から人々を守るヒーロー。普通の蝙蝠と間違われて、守るべき人々からよく攻撃されるのが悩みの種。特技は死んだふり。"
en: The bat god. A hero who under the cover of darkness protects people from disease and demons. It often gets mistaken for a normal bat and is attacked by the people it is supposed to protect. It's good at playing dead.
en_grezzo: "The bat god. A hero who under the cover of darkness protects people from disease and demons. It often gets mistaken for a normal bat and is attacked by the people it is supposed to protect. It's good at playing dead."
it: Il dio dei pipistrelli. Un eroe che, confondendosi con il buio, difende la gente dalle malattie e dai demoni. Il suo cruccio è che lo scambiano spesso per un pipistrello qualunque e finisce attaccato proprio da quelli che dovrebbe proteggere. La sua specialità è fingersi morto.

jp: 人間たちが戦争している様子を遠巻きに観察して、戦闘技術を独自に学んだ蝙蝠。銃の扱いを覚えたが、兵士たちの口汚い罵倒まで覚えてしまった。
jp_grezzo: "人間たちが戦争している様子を遠巻きに観察して、戦闘技術を独自に学んだ蝙蝠。銃の扱いを覚えたが、兵士たちの口汚い罵倒まで覚えてしまった。"
en: Bats have learned their own fighting skills by observing the humans at war from a distance. They learned how to handle the guns and even learned the foul-mouthed abuse of the soldiers.
en_grezzo: "Bats have learned their own fighting skills by observing the humans at war from a distance. They learned how to handle the guns and even learned the foul-mouthed abuse of the soldiers."
it: Un pipistrello che, osservando da lontano gli uomini che si facevano la guerra, si è imparato da sé la tecnica del combattimento. Ha imparato a maneggiare le armi da fuoco, e insieme a quelle si è imparato anche il turpiloquio dei soldati.

jp: やけにでかい蝙蝠だと思ったら、なんと妖怪らしい。樹の穴に住み、子供の泣き声で人々をおびき寄せる。気に入った子供はさらい、そうでない子供や大人には噛みついてくる。
jp_grezzo: "やけにでかい蝙蝠だと思ったら、なんと妖怪らしい。樹の穴に住み、子供の泣き声で人々をおびき寄せる。気に入った子供はさらい、そうでない子供や大人には噛みついてくる。"
en: It looks to be a very large bat but it seems to be a monster. They live in a hole in the tree and lure people in with the cries of children. Kids who like it will be snatched and kids and adults who don't will be bitten by it.
en_grezzo: "It looks to be a very large bat but it seems to be a monster. They live in a hole in the tree and lure people in with the cries of children. Kids who like it will be snatched and kids and adults who don't will be bitten by it."
it: Sembrava un pipistrello smisuratamente grosso, e invece pare che sia uno spirito. Abita nel cavo di un albero e attira la gente col pianto di un bambino. I bambini che gli piacciono se li porta via; quelli che non gli piacciono, e gli adulti, li morde e basta.

jp: 究極の力に目覚めたネズミ。普通のネズミと大きさはそう変わらないが戦闘力は段違い。さらに、「究鼠猫を噛み殺し、ついでにインド象も殺す」というコトワザがあるくらい凶暴。
jp_grezzo: "究極の力に目覚めたネズミ。普通のネズミと大きさはそう変わらないが戦闘力は段違い。さらに、「究鼠猫を噛み殺し、ついでにインド象も殺す」というコトワザがあるくらい凶暴。"
en: The rats have awakened to their ultimate power. It's no different in size from a normal rat but it's fighting power is much different. In addition there is a saying that they bite and kill the ultimate rat cat and eventually kill the Indian elephant.
en_grezzo: "The rats have awakened to their ultimate power. It's no different in size from a normal rat but it's fighting power is much different. In addition there is a saying that they bite and kill the ultimate rat cat and eventually kill the Indian elephant."
it: Un topo che si è risvegliato alla forza suprema. Di taglia non è granché diverso da un topo comune, ma la forza in combattimento è un'altra cosa. Ed è talmente feroce che c'è perfino un detto: il ratto sommo ammazza il gatto a morsi, e già che c'è ammazza anche l'elefante indiano.

jp: 災厄の象徴とされる巨大ハムスター。その旺盛な食欲と繁殖力により一帯の食物を食い尽くしてしまう。さらに、伸び続ける前歯を削るため樹木や柱にかじりつくので、森も建物も残らない。
jp_grezzo: "災厄の象徴とされる巨大ハムスター。その旺盛な食欲と繁殖力により一帯の食物を食い尽くしてしまう。さらに、伸び続ける前歯を削るため樹木や柱にかじりつくので、森も建物も残らない。"
en: A giant hamster that is considered a symbol of disaster. Its voracious appetite and fecundity will devour the food in the area. In addition the trees and pillars are gnawed by the ever-growing front teeth so no forests or buildings are left behind.
en_grezzo: "A giant hamster that is considered a symbol of disaster. Its voracious appetite and fecundity will devour the food in the area. In addition the trees and pillars are gnawed by the ever-growing front teeth so no forests or buildings are left behind."
it: Un criceto gigantesco, che passa per il simbolo della calamità. Con quell'appetito smisurato e quella facilità a riprodursi divora tutto il cibo della zona. E siccome per limarsi gli incisivi, che gli crescono senza mai fermarsi, si mette a rosicchiare alberi e pilastri, non restano in piedi né i boschi né gli edifici.

jp: 老いたハムスターが化けたもの。ハムスターの世界では、ハム将軍に仕える最高位の存在。遊ぶためにしょっちゅう脱走していなくなるので、代わりが何匹もいる。
jp_grezzo: "老いたハムスターが化けたもの。ハムスターの世界では、ハム将軍に仕える最高位の存在。遊ぶためにしょっちゅう脱走していなくなるので、代わりが何匹もいる。"
en: An elderly hamster disguised as an older hamster. In the hamster world he is the highest ranking being in the service of General Ham. They often escape to play so there are a number of substitutes.
en_grezzo: "An elderly hamster disguised as an older hamster. In the hamster world he is the highest ranking being in the service of General Ham. They often escape to play so there are a number of substitutes."
it: È un criceto che, invecchiando, si è trasformato in altro. Nel mondo dei criceti è il grado più alto al servizio del criceto generale. Siccome scappa di continuo per andare a giocare e non lo si trova mai, di sostituti ce n'è più d'uno.

jp: 初代ミノタウロスの別名と同じ名前を持つ牛人。星、雷光を意味する名前。ミノタウロスの中でも神がかり的な強さを持つ者だけが、こう名乗ることを許されている。
jp_grezzo: "初代ミノタウロスの別名と同じ名前を持つ牛人。星、雷光を意味する名前。ミノタウロスの中でも神がかり的な強さを持つ者だけが、こう名乗ることを許されている。"
en: A cattleman with the same name as the alias of the first Minotaur. The name means star or thunderbolt. Only those with divine strength among the minotaurs are allowed to call themselves so.
en_grezzo: "A cattleman with the same name as the alias of the first Minotaur. The name means star or thunderbolt. Only those with divine strength among the minotaurs are allowed to call themselves so."
it: Un uomo toro che porta lo stesso nome con cui si chiamava anche il primo minotauro. È un nome che vuol dire stella, e anche lampo. Fra i minotauri, a chiamarsi così sono ammessi soltanto quelli che hanno una forza da far pensare a un dio.

jp: 人の身体に牛の頭と蹄を持つ。今でこそ化け物扱いだが、元は武器の神。性格は勇敢で忍耐強く、霧を操る能力を持つ。
jp_grezzo: "人の身体に牛の頭と蹄を持つ。今でこそ化け物扱いだが、元は武器の神。性格は勇敢で忍耐強く、霧を操る能力を持つ。"
en: A human body with the head and hooves of a cow. He is now a monster but he was once a god of weapons. His personality is brave and patient and he has the ability to control the fog.
en_grezzo: "A human body with the head and hooves of a cow. He is now a monster but he was once a god of weapons. His personality is brave and patient and he has the ability to control the fog."
it: Ha corpo d'uomo, testa e zoccoli di bue. Oggi lo trattano da mostro, ma in origine era il dio delle armi. Di carattere è coraggioso e paziente, e ha la facoltà di comandare la nebbia.

jp: 青い身体にものすごい力を秘めた雄牛。自分の力を制御できないことでブルーになり、よくブルブル震えている。直接話したことはないが、ブルーバブルにはなんだか親近感を覚えている。
jp_grezzo: "青い身体にものすごい力を秘めた雄牛。自分の力を制御できないことでブルーになり、よくブルブル震えている。直接話したことはないが、ブルーバブルにはなんだか親近感を覚えている。"
en: A bull with a blue body and tremendous power. They are blue from not being able to control their own power and are often burbling and shaking. I've never spoken to them directly but I feel somehow familiar with the Blue Bubble.
en_grezzo: "A bull with a blue body and tremendous power. They are blue from not being able to control their own power and are often burbling and shaking. I've never spoken to them directly but I feel somehow familiar with the Blue Bubble."
it: Un toro dal corpo azzurro, che dentro nasconde una forza spaventosa. Non riuscendo a controllarla gli viene il magone, e se ne sta lì a tremare come una foglia. Con la bolla azzurra non ci ha mai parlato di persona, ma prova per lei una specie di simpatia.

jp: 超古代の頃から搾乳や精肉のために家畜として扱われている。ミノタウロスたちからは祖先として神聖視されており、牛を解放するためにミノタウロスが人を襲うこともあるのだとか。
jp_grezzo: "超古代の頃から搾乳や精肉のために家畜として扱われている。ミノタウロスたちからは祖先として神聖視されており、牛を解放するためにミノタウロスが人を襲うこともあるのだとか。"
en: They have been domesticated for milking and for meat since ancient times. The cattle are considered sacred as ancestors by the minotaurs and the minotaurs sometimes attack people in order to free the cattle.
en_grezzo: "They have been domesticated for milking and for meat since ancient times. The cattle are considered sacred as ancestors by the minotaurs and the minotaurs sometimes attack people in order to free the cattle."
it: Fin dall'antichità più remota lo tengono come bestia da allevamento, per il latte e per la carne. I minotauri lo venerano come antenato, e pare che a volte assalgano gli uomini proprio per liberare i bovini.

jp: ケンタウロスの中では珍しく、魔術と近接戦闘術に秀でる。派手好きな性格で、元からピカピカの鎧をさらに魔力でもって発光させている。基本的に雄しかいない。
jp_grezzo: "ケンタウロスの中では珍しく、魔術と近接戦闘術に秀でる。派手好きな性格で、元からピカピカの鎧をさらに魔力でもって発光させている。基本的に雄しかいない。"
en: Rare among the centaurs he excels in magic and melee combat. He has a flair for flamboyance making his original shiny armor glow with even more magical power. Basically there are only males.
en_grezzo: "Rare among the centaurs he excels in magic and melee combat. He has a flair for flamboyance making his original shiny armor glow with even more magical power. Basically there are only males."
it: Fra i centauri è raro: eccelle insieme nella magia e nel combattimento ravvicinato. Ama farsi notare, e l'armatura, che è già lucida di suo, se la fa pure risplendere con il potere magico. Di regola ne esistono soltanto maschi.

jp: 闇の力を得て強化された馬。その実力は未知数で、世間一般からは大して注目されていないし期待もされていない。一方、ダークホース自身はそんな評価を気にしていない。馬耳東風というやつである。
jp_grezzo: "闇の力を得て強化された馬。その実力は未知数で、世間一般からは大して注目されていないし期待もされていない。一方、ダークホース自身はそんな評価を気にしていない。馬耳東風というやつである。"
en: A horse that has been strengthened with the power of darkness. His abilities are unknown and he does not receive much attention or expectation from the general public. Dark Horse itself on the other hand isn't concerned about that assessment.
en_grezzo: "A horse that has been strengthened with the power of darkness. His abilities are unknown and he does not receive much attention or expectation from the general public. Dark Horse itself on the other hand isn't concerned about that assessment."
it: Un cavallo rinforzato dalla forza delle tenebre. Quanto valga davvero non lo sa nessuno, e la gente non gli bada e non si aspetta niente da lui. Al cavallo nero, però, quel giudizio non fa né caldo né freddo: gli entra da un orecchio ed esce dall'altro.

jp: 全身鎧を身に着けたケンタウロス。単騎での戦いを好み、プライドも戦闘力も高い。よほど馴れた相手でもない限り、胴体に乗せることを嫌う。
jp_grezzo: "全身鎧を身に着けたケンタウロス。単騎での戦いを好み、プライドも戦闘力も高い。よほど馴れた相手でもない限り、胴体に乗せることを嫌う。"
en: A centaur wearing full body armor. He prefers to fight alone and has a high level of pride and fighting power. He doesn't like to be put on his armor unless his opponent is very skilled.
en_grezzo: "A centaur wearing full body armor. He prefers to fight alone and has a high level of pride and fighting power. He doesn't like to be put on his armor unless his opponent is very skilled."
it: Un centauro coperto da un'armatura completa. Preferisce combattere da solo, e ha tanto orgoglio quanta forza. A meno che non si tratti di qualcuno con cui ha davvero confidenza, non sopporta di farselo montare in groppa.

jp: 小さめのバリスタであれば単独で扱えるように訓練された軍馬。馬の筋力を持ってしてもバリスタは相当重いらしく、足を止めて構えないと撃てない模様。
jp_grezzo: "小さめのバリスタであれば単独で扱えるように訓練された軍馬。馬の筋力を持ってしてもバリスタは相当重いらしく、足を止めて構えないと撃てない模様。"
en: A military horse trained to handle a small ballista on its own. Even with the muscle strength of a horse the ballista seems to be quite heavy and it cannot be shot unless it stops its feet and takes a posture.
en_grezzo: "A military horse trained to handle a small ballista on its own. Even with the muscle strength of a horse the ballista seems to be quite heavy and it cannot be shot unless it stops its feet and takes a posture."
it: Un cavallo da guerra addestrato a servire da solo una balista, purché sia di quelle piccole. Nemmeno con i muscoli di un cavallo la balista è leggera, a quanto pare: per sparare deve fermarsi e mettersi in posizione.

jp: 弓矢から銃に乗り換えたケンタウロス。疾走しながら遠方のインド象の眉間を撃ち抜くなど、反射神経と運動能力に秀でる。好きなものはボルトアクション。
jp_grezzo: "弓矢から銃に乗り換えたケンタウロス。疾走しながら遠方のインド象の眉間を撃ち抜くなど、反射神経と運動能力に秀でる。好きなものはボルトアクション。"
en: The centaurs have switched from bows and arrows to guns. It excels in reflexes and athleticism such as shooting a distant Indian elephant between the eyebrows while sprinting. Their favorite thing is bolt action.
en_grezzo: "The centaurs have switched from bows and arrows to guns. It excels in reflexes and athleticism such as shooting a distant Indian elephant between the eyebrows while sprinting. Their favorite thing is bolt action."
it: Un centauro che ha lasciato l'arco per l'arma da fuoco. Ha riflessi e prontezza fuori dal comune: mentre corre a perdifiato prende un elefante indiano lontanissimo in mezzo agli occhi. La cosa che gli piace di più è l'otturatore a scorrimento.

jp: 半人半馬の生物。普通の馬より重心が前にあるため、前傾姿勢を取ろうものならひっくり返りそうになる。群れで狩猟や農耕をして生活する。
jp_grezzo: "半人半馬の生物。普通の馬より重心が前にあるため、前傾姿勢を取ろうものならひっくり返りそうになる。群れで狩猟や農耕をして生活する。"
en: A half-man half-horse creature. Their center of gravity is more forward than a normal horse so if they try to lean forward they might fall over. They live by hunting and farming in herds.
en_grezzo: "A half-man half-horse creature. Their center of gravity is more forward than a normal horse so if they try to lean forward they might fall over. They live by hunting and farming in herds."
it: Una creatura metà uomo e metà cavallo. Ha il baricentro più avanti di un cavallo normale, e se prova a sporgersi in avanti rischia di ribaltarsi. Vive in gruppo, di caccia e di agricoltura.

jp: パンを愛しすぎた精霊が、焼きたてのパンと一つになった姿。パンの構成物質の６割が、ショクパンヨリフランスパンという謎の超硬度物質に変化している。硬さを活かして体当たりで物を破壊する。
jp_grezzo: "パンを愛しすぎた精霊が、焼きたてのパンと一つになった姿。パンの構成物質の６割が、ショクパンヨリフランスパンという謎の超硬度物質に変化している。硬さを活かして体当たりで物を破壊する。"
en: A spirit who loved the bread too much became one with the freshly baked bread. Sixty percent of the bread's constituents have been transformed into a mysterious super-hard substance called shoku panyori French bread. He uses his hardness to destroy objects with his body hit.
en_grezzo: "A spirit who loved the bread too much became one with the freshly baked bread. Sixty percent of the bread's constituents have been transformed into a mysterious super-hard substance called shoku panyori French bread. He uses his hardness to destroy objects with his body hit."
it: Uno spirito che amava il pane troppo, e che si è fatto tutt'uno con una pagnotta appena sfornata. Il sessanta per cento di quello che compone il pane si è mutato in una misteriosa sostanza durissima chiamata megliobaguettechepancarré. Quella durezza se la sfrutta: distrugge le cose prendendole a testate.

jp: 無数の魂と融合したウィスプ。怒りや憎悪に狂った魂の影響で、激しく燃え盛る。動きは緩慢だが、相手の魂ごと肉体を引き寄せるため逃げ切るのは難しい。
jp_grezzo: "無数の魂と融合したウィスプ。怒りや憎悪に狂った魂の影響で、激しく燃え盛る。動きは緩慢だが、相手の魂ごと肉体を引き寄せるため逃げ切るのは難しい。"
en: A wisp fused with countless souls. It burns fiercely under the influence of a soul crazed with anger and hatred. Its movements are slow but it is difficult to escape because it pulls the body and soul of the opponent towards it.
en_grezzo: "A wisp fused with countless souls. It burns fiercely under the influence of a soul crazed with anger and hatred. Its movements are slow but it is difficult to escape because it pulls the body and soul of the opponent towards it."
it: Un fuoco fatuo che si è fuso con anime a non finire. Sotto l'influenza di quelle impazzite di rabbia e di odio arde con una violenza tremenda. Si muove lento, ma scappargli via è difficile: tira a sé il corpo dell'avversario con tutta l'anima dentro.

jp: 極限にまで発達した放電雲が、多量の水蒸気を取り込んで変容した姿。天候に大きな影響を及ぼす。風の吹くまま気の向くまま、流されるように上空を浮遊しながら鳥を狩って生活する。
jp_grezzo: "極限にまで発達した放電雲が、多量の水蒸気を取り込んで変容した姿。天候に大きな影響を及ぼす。風の吹くまま気の向くまま、流されるように上空を浮遊しながら鳥を狩って生活する。"
en: An extremely developed discharge cloud that has been transformed by taking in a large amount of water vapor. It has a huge impact on the weather. They live by hunting birds while hovering in the air as if they were being swept away by the wind whenever the wind blows.
en_grezzo: "An extremely developed discharge cloud that has been transformed by taking in a large amount of water vapor. It has a huge impact on the weather. They live by hunting birds while hovering in the air as if they were being swept away by the wind whenever the wind blows."
it: È una nube temporalesca cresciuta fino all'estremo, che a forza di inghiottire vapore acqueo ha cambiato forma. Sul tempo atmosferico pesa parecchio. Vive cacciando uccelli mentre galleggia lassù in alto, portato dove tira il vento e dove gli gira, come se lo trascinasse la corrente.

jp: コアから四方に延びたモアイが特徴的。モアイ部分は推進装置であるとともに強固な盾。コアがダメージを受けないように、モアイの石頭で攻撃を受け止める。
jp_grezzo: "コアから四方に延びたモアイが特徴的。モアイ部分は推進装置であるとともに強固な盾。コアがダメージを受けないように、モアイの石頭で攻撃を受け止める。"
en: It features a moai extending from the core on all four sides. The moai part is a strong shield as well as a propulsion device. To prevent the core from taking damage the moai's stone head parries the attack.
en_grezzo: "It features a moai extending from the core on all four sides. The moai part is a strong shield as well as a propulsion device. To prevent the core from taking damage the moai's stone head parries the attack."
it: Lo si riconosce dai moai che gli si allungano dal nucleo verso i quattro lati. La parte dei moai è insieme il propulsore e uno scudo solido. Perché il nucleo non prenda danno, sono le teste di pietra dei moai a incassare i colpi.

jp: 複雑な魔法回路が刻まれており、板部分に膨大な魔力を溜めることができる。仮初の生命を与えられており、自律行動が可能。前線への魔力補給装置や施設用魔力電池として秘密裏に試験運用されている。
jp_grezzo: "複雑な魔法回路が刻まれており、板部分に膨大な魔力を溜めることができる。仮初の生命を与えられており、自律行動が可能。前線への魔力補給装置や施設用魔力電池として秘密裏に試験運用されている。"
en: A complex magic circuit is carved into the board and a huge amount of magic can be stored in the board. It has been given a provisional life and is capable of autonomous action. It is secretly tested and operated as a magical power supply device for the front lines and as a magical power battery for facilities.
en_grezzo: "A complex magic circuit is carved into the board and a huge amount of magic can be stored in the board. It has been given a provisional life and is capable of autonomous action. It is secretly tested and operated as a magical power supply device for the front lines and as a magical power battery for facilities."
it: Porta inciso un circuito magico complicato, e nella lastra può accumulare una quantità enorme di potere magico. Gli hanno dato una vita provvisoria, e così si muove da sé. Lo stanno provando di nascosto come rifornitore di potere magico per la prima linea e come batteria magica per gli impianti.

jp: 地雷を撒きまくる困ったモアイ。必要以上に強力なセンサーを搭載しており、自身は地雷に引っかからない。地雷犬からライバル視されているが、そのことについては特に興味がない模様。
jp_grezzo: "地雷を撒きまくる困ったモアイ。必要以上に強力なセンサーを搭載しており、自身は地雷に引っかからない。地雷犬からライバル視されているが、そのことについては特に興味がない模様。"
en: A troubled moai scattering landmines. With sensors that are more powerful than necessary he doesn't get caught by mines himself. He is regarded as a rival by landmine dogs but he doesn't seem to care about that.
en_grezzo: "A troubled moai scattering landmines. With sensors that are more powerful than necessary he doesn't get caught by mines himself. He is regarded as a rival by landmine dogs but he doesn't seem to care about that."
it: Un moai fastidioso che semina mine a più non posso. Monta sensori più potenti del necessario, e nelle mine non ci finisce mai lui. Il cane mina lo tratta da rivale, ma a lui della faccenda pare non importi niente.

jp: 先代の収穫の神が使役していた魔物。大雨の夜、首のない死体から一斉に生えてきたという。関連する伝承が世界各地に多く残っており、今日では死神というと一般的にこの魔物のことを指す。
jp_grezzo: "先代の収穫の神が使役していた魔物。大雨の夜、首のない死体から一斉に生えてきたという。関連する伝承が世界各地に多く残っており、今日では死神というと一般的にこの魔物のことを指す。"
en: A demon that was used by the previous god of harvest. It is said that on a night of heavy rains a batch of headless corpses grew out of them. Many related lore survives throughout the world and today the term reaper generally refers to this demon.
en_grezzo: "A demon that was used by the previous god of harvest. It is said that on a night of heavy rains a batch of headless corpses grew out of them. Many related lore survives throughout the world and today the term reaper generally refers to this demon."
it: Un mostro che il precedente dio del raccolto teneva al proprio servizio. Si racconta che in una notte di pioggia battente ne siano spuntati tutti insieme da certi cadaveri senza testa. Di leggende su di lui ne restano tante in ogni parte del mondo, e oggi, quando si dice la morte, di solito si intende lui.

jp: 死を超越しようとして禁忌に手を出した者の成れの果て。シズルコードと呼ばれる魔術書を一部解読し、その秘術でアンデッドを身体に取り込んだが失敗。本当は綺麗に融合し、３対の翼が生えてくるはずだった。
jp_grezzo: "死を超越しようとして禁忌に手を出した者の成れの果て。シズルコードと呼ばれる魔術書を一部解読し、その秘術でアンデッドを身体に取り込んだが失敗。本当は綺麗に融合し、３対の翼が生えてくるはずだった。"
en: It is the result of those who try to transcend death and meddle with the taboo. He deciphered a part of a magic book called the Ssil Code and used its magic to bring the undead into his body but failed. In truth they should have fused beautifully and sprouted three pairs of wings.
en_grezzo: "It is the result of those who try to transcend death and meddle with the taboo. He deciphered a part of a magic book called the Ssil Code and used its magic to bring the undead into his body but failed. In truth they should have fused beautifully and sprouted three pairs of wings."
it: È il punto d'arrivo di chi ha voluto superare la morte e ha messo le mani sul proibito. Decifrò una parte del libro di magia che chiamano il Codice di Ssil e, con quell'arte segreta, si fece entrare in corpo un non morto: ma andò male. Nelle intenzioni i due dovevano fondersi alla perfezione, e sarebbero dovute spuntare tre paia d'ali.

jp: どこかのネクロマンサーが作った、ツギハギの幽鬼。名前もそのまま、古代の人造語で「ツギハギ」という意味である。無理に取り付けたため身体はアンバランス。自我はアンバランスどころか崩壊済み。
jp_grezzo: "どこかのネクロマンサーが作った、ツギハギの幽鬼。名前もそのまま、古代の人造語で「ツギハギ」という意味である。無理に取り付けたため身体はアンバランス。自我はアンバランスどころか崩壊済み。"
en: A gnarled ghost created by a necromancer somewhere. The name is also intact meaning Tsugihagi in an ancient artificial language. The body is unbalanced due to the forced installation. The ego is far from unbalanced it's broken.
en_grezzo: "A gnarled ghost created by a necromancer somewhere. The name is also intact meaning Tsugihagi in an ancient artificial language. The body is unbalanced due to the forced installation. The ego is far from unbalanced it's broken."
it: Uno spettro rattoppato, opera di un negromante di chissà dove. Anche il nome dice quello e nient'altro: in un'antica lingua artificiale vuol dire proprio rattoppato. I pezzi glieli hanno attaccati a forza, e il corpo è tutto sbilanciato. L'io, più che sbilanciato, è andato in pezzi da un pezzo.

jp: 国同士の抗争で使い潰されていくことに疑問を持ち、同志を集めて傭兵団を結成した。優れたサバイバリティで戦友達を何度も救っており、彼を師と仰ぐ傭兵も多い。傭兵の仕事がない時は実家で農業をしている。
jp_grezzo: "国同士の抗争で使い潰されていくことに疑問を持ち、同志を集めて傭兵団を結成した。優れたサバイバリティで戦友達を何度も救っており、彼を師と仰ぐ傭兵も多い。傭兵の仕事がない時は実家で農業をしている。"
en: Concerned about being consumed by the war between the nations he gathered his comrades and formed a mercenary group. He has saved his comrades many times with his superior survivorship and many mercenaries look up to him as a mentor. When he's not working as a mercenary he's farming at his parents' house.
en_grezzo: "Concerned about being consumed by the war between the nations he gathered his comrades and formed a mercenary group. He has saved his comrades many times with his superior survivorship and many mercenaries look up to him as a mentor. When he's not working as a mercenary he's farming at his parents' house."
it: Si chiese perché mai dovesse lasciarsi consumare nelle liti fra un paese e l'altro, e allora raccolse dei compagni e mise in piedi una compagnia di ventura. Ha salvato i commilitoni infinite volte, tanto sa cavarsela, e non pochi mercenari lo prendono per maestro. Quando non c'è lavoro da mercenario, torna a casa dei suoi a fare il contadino.

jp: 黒いオーラの部分が本体。バフォメットの死骸を操って活動する。細菌を魔術で生成・制御して甚大な被害をもたらす。だが扱うのが封印当時の細菌ベースで、制御なしだとイルヴァの現代生物にはほぼ効かない。
jp_grezzo: "黒いオーラの部分が本体。バフォメットの死骸を操って活動する。細菌を魔術で生成・制御して甚大な被害をもたらす。だが扱うのが封印当時の細菌ベースで、制御なしだとイルヴァの現代生物にはほぼ効かない。"
en: The black aura is the main body. It operates by manipulating the corpse of Baphomet. The germs are generated and controlled by magic to cause great damage. But the infection is based on germs from the time of the sealing and without control it is almost ineffective against modern creatures in Irva.
en_grezzo: "The black aura is the main body. It operates by manipulating the corpse of Baphomet. The germs are generated and controlled by magic to cause great damage. But the infection is based on germs from the time of the sealing and without control it is almost ineffective against modern creatures in Irva."
it: Quello vero è l'alone nero: si muove manovrando il cadavere di un Baphomet. Genera e governa i batteri con la magia, e i danni che ne vengono sono enormi. Solo che i batteri da cui parte sono quelli di quando lo sigillarono, e senza il suo governo sulle creature della Irva di oggi non fanno quasi niente.

jp: 闇魔術で徹底的に強化されたなめくじ。どこかの悪質な魔法使いが面白半分で作り出し、野外に放ったものが大繁殖した。野生のかたつむりたちからは「なんか暗くて近寄りがたい」と思われている。
jp_grezzo: "闇魔術で徹底的に強化されたなめくじ。どこかの悪質な魔法使いが面白半分で作り出し、野外に放ったものが大繁殖した。野生のかたつむりたちからは「なんか暗くて近寄りがたい」と思われている。"
en: A slug that has been thoroughly enhanced with dark magic. A vicious wizard somewhere created it for fun and released it into the open air where it multiplied greatly. The wild beetles think it's dark and unapproachable.
en_grezzo: "A slug that has been thoroughly enhanced with dark magic. A vicious wizard somewhere created it for fun and released it into the open air where it multiplied greatly. The wild beetles think it's dark and unapproachable."
it: Una lumaca rinforzata da cima a fondo con la magia oscura. Un mago malintenzionato di chissà dove la creò per puro divertimento e la liberò all'aperto, e quella si moltiplicò a dismisura. Le chiocciole selvatiche dicono di lei che è un tipo cupo, e che avvicinarla mette soggezione.

jp: 元は普通の殻だったが、人間に依頼して高性能な大砲と機銃を搭載したかたつむり。残念ながらバランス制御が困難で扱いきれず、機銃を単発で撃つのが精一杯の模様。
jp_grezzo: "元は普通の殻だったが、人間に依頼して高性能な大砲と機銃を搭載したかたつむり。残念ながらバランス制御が困難で扱いきれず、機銃を単発で撃つのが精一杯の模様。"
en: Originally an ordinary shell the snail was equipped with a high-powered cannon and machine gun at the request of humans. Unfortunately the balance control is too difficult to handle and it seems that it is all it can do is shoot the machine gun in single shots.
en_grezzo: "Originally an ordinary shell the snail was equipped with a high-powered cannon and machine gun at the request of humans. Unfortunately the balance control is too difficult to handle and it seems that it is all it can do is shoot the machine gun in single shots."
it: Il guscio in origine era di quelli normali, poi la chiocciola si è fatta montare dagli uomini un cannone e una mitragliatrice di tutto rispetto. Purtroppo tenere l'equilibrio è troppo difficile e non riesce a governarli: pare che il massimo che sappia fare sia sparare colpi singoli con la mitragliatrice.

jp: かたつむり一族繁栄につながると信じて命を懸ける。殻の中に爆薬を詰め込んで突進するが、大抵は接近する前に処理されてしまう。その命は風に舞い散るほど軽い…。
jp_grezzo: "かたつむり一族繁栄につながると信じて命を懸ける。殻の中に爆薬を詰め込んで突進するが、大抵は接近する前に処理されてしまう。その命は風に舞い散るほど軽い…。"
en: They believe that this will lead to the prosperity of the Snail family and they are willing to put their lives on the line. They charge at you with explosives packed into their shells but most of the time they are dealt with before you can approach them. Its life is so light that it flutters in the wind...
en_grezzo: "They believe that this will lead to the prosperity of the Snail family and they are willing to put their lives on the line. They charge at you with explosives packed into their shells but most of the time they are dealt with before you can approach them. Its life is so light that it flutters in the wind..."
it: Ci mette la vita, convinta che così la stirpe delle chiocciole prospererà. Si riempie il guscio di esplosivo e carica, ma quasi sempre la sistemano prima ancora che sia arrivata. La sua vita è leggera al punto di volare via nel vento...
